title: betula lenta subsp. uber
intro: Betula lenta subsp. uber, commonly known as Yellow Birch, is a subspecies of the Betula lenta tree. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional folk medicine. The health benefits of Yellow Birch include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate various health issues such as wound healing and infections. The bioactive constituents of Yellow Birch include salicin, a compound similar to aspirin, as well as betulin and other triterpenes, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
